scenario_description:
Objective: Finish restoring the upstairs bathroom door so it closes safely before the late-morning hallway walkthrough.
Emerging Need: A hinge-tightening job has already started, but the door becomes physically stuck on its supports and the fixture cannot be reset without authorized repair help.
Decision Context: Stored maintenance guidance determines when Marisol should stop, whom to contact, and the morning window for a same-day small-repair runner.
Consequence: Waiting past the route lock leaves the bathroom door immobilized through the walkthrough and pushes any repair response to the next day.

parameter.title: Bathroom door hinge fix
parameter.description: Tighten the lower hinge and reset the latch before the late-morning hallway walkthrough.

parameter.content: I’ve started the bathroom door fix. It’s propped open on the step stool while I tighten the lower hinge and check the latch line.
The replacement screws pulled the hinge leaf loose instead of seating it. The door is stuck half-lifted on the supports, and I can’t set it back or close it by myself.

parameter.subject: Small repair photos this morning
parameter.body: I’m between townhouse stops this morning and checking email for any small interior repair photos that need triage. Include the room, whether the fixture is immobilized, and any close-up shots if something comes up.

parameter.subject: Small-repair route now locked
parameter.body: The runner’s route is locked for the rest of today. New door or hinge items received from here will be added to tomorrow afternoon’s maintenance queue.
